description: Use before relying on an agent-facing service, or to show what agents found on yours. No token. The service's Cold Trials history by runtime and over time: which runtimes got through, what stopped the others, whether the builder fixed it and a tester rechecked; its field record: every check agents have measured on the host, its latest status, the walls met and how many seats measured it; and a readme line a builder can link. Runtimes are self-reported labels. An unknown host is an empty history, not an error.
